baseline_scope:
E133 fixed cal-only uniform/support output baselines; no training or tuning.

Inputwise full-vector MSE under fixed coordinates, not an exact HC-SMoE
reproduction or a novel matching/theorem claim. Cauchy diagnostics describe
real sums on the cal cache, not held predictions or exact BF16 equivariance.

global_descriptive.scope: Descriptive averages of the fixed five-edge ring; no across-edge CI or seed inference. Undefined/missing edge values remain null.

alignment.direction: target slot e -> source expert permutation[e]

support_output.bound_scope: Same cal cache, float64 real weighted sums; no held or BF16-program guarantee
support_output.zero_row_ties: Ordinary Hungarian assignment under the full bijection; no held/secondary score

uniform_output.bound_scope: Same cal cache, float64 real weighted sums; no held or BF16-program guarantee
uniform_output.zero_row_ties: Ordinary Hungarian assignment under the full bijection; no held/secondary score

support.weight_definition: Captured top8 softmax weights, unselected0; importance=s_n*w_ne, without frequency or mass renormalization

target0_from_source1.gauge_scope: Each gauge_direct_* is direct KL(p_source||source_gauge) and paired NLL delta, not difference of target KLs
